How To Play Mahjong Solitaire:

The goal of the puzzle game Mah jongg is to remove all the tiles from the mah jongg games by matching pairs of identical tiles. When you match a pair, it will disappear and reveal what was under it. You can only remove majong tiles that are free and not covered or between other tiles. Match them all and you solve the puzzle.
